t: This is Warwick Avenue tube station, on the Bakerloo line in Little Venice, in the City of Westminster. It sits between Maida Vale and Paddington, in fare zone 2. The station was designed by Stanley Heaps, an English architect who lived from 1880 to 1962. Heaps designed a number of stations on the London Underground, and he also designed train depots and bus and trolleybus garages for London Transport. So this is one piece of a much wider body of work.
